description: atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr: flood hazard datasets (alea inondation) is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr.
